svg.desc: Qataf Mixed-Use Complex LOCATION Al Khobar, KSA CLIENT Qataf Real Estate Development COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2015 35 million SAR DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Structural / Civil Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2015, this mixed-use project in Al Khobar covered master planning and conceptual civil design for a 175,000 m2 development. BECT designed the water and wastewater networks, irrigation systems and road infrastructure, supporting an integrated urban environment for Qataf Real Estate Development within an 11-month consultancy assignment.
